sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced "Marriage Assistance" for the employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced "Marriage Assistance" with a sum of Rs.10,000/- for both male and female is given as Marriage Assistance to employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.
**Benefits / Assistance:** A sum of Rs.10,000/- for both male and female is given as Marriage Assistance to employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.

**Application Process:** Applicants who require the [application form](https://www.lwb.tn.gov.in/forms/Marriage_assistance.pdf) in person or self-addressed Rs.- Postage It can be obtained through the enclosed envelope.  Address to apply.- Secretary, Tamil Nadu Professional Welfare Board, PO Box No. 718, T.M.S. Campus, Thenampet, Chennai-600 006.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour and Employment Department
**Tags:** Tamil Nadu, Marriage, Employees, Son, Daughter
